description: This file defines the Gauge interface, which is a type of metric instrument used to represent an instantaneous measurement of a long value, with capabilities to increment, decrement, set, and get its value within a metrics collection framework.

classes.name: Gauge
classes.description: An interface representing a gauge metric instrument that allows incrementing, decrementing, setting, and retrieving a long value, used for instantaneous measurements within a metrics system.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Increments the gauge value by one and returns the gauge.

methods.name: decrement
methods.description: Decrements the gauge value by one and returns the gauge.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the gauge to a specific long value.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the current value of the gauge.
